sh:property.sh:name: Event Time Zone Offset
sh:property.sh:description: Offset to UTC. Summer and winter time need to be considered

sh:property.sh:name: Master Data Reference ID
sh:property.sh:description: The ID, the master data declared refers to
sh:property.sh:message: Master data entry should contain an id

sh:sparql.sh:message: masterDataAvailableFor ids should be referenced within the event
sh:sparql.sh:select: SELECT $this WHERE {$this epcis:masterDataAvailableFor ?md . ?md epcis:id ?id . FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this ?p ?id .}}

sh:property.sh:name: Measurement Time Stamp
sh:property.sh:description: The date and time the measurement took place

sh:property.sh:name: Measuring Device ID
sh:property.sh:description: The ID of the device, with which the measurement was carried out

sh:property.sh:name: Parent of an Aggregation Event
sh:property.sh:description: The ID, into which the aggregation takes place
sh:property.sh:message: AggregationEvent must have exactly one parent

sh:property.sh:name: Children of an Aggregation Event
sh:property.sh:description: The IDs, which are aggregated into the parentID
sh:property.sh:message: AggregationEvent must have at least one child

sh:property.sh:name: Parent of an Association Event
sh:property.sh:description: The ID, with which the association is done
sh:property.sh:message: AssociationEvent must have exactly one parent

sh:property.sh:name: Children of an Association Event
sh:property.sh:description: The IDs, which are associated with the parentID
sh:property.sh:message: AssociationEvent must have at least one child

sh:property.sh:name: Read Point ID
sh:property.sh:description: The ID of the point, where the event reading takes place
sh:property.sh:message: ReadPoint should include an id (GLN or URI)

sh:property.sh:name: Software Version
sh:property.sh:message: Software version must be a string
